purpose: Optional external review adapters for SciXZ manuscript-review and revision routes.
policy: Optional external reviews are advisory evidence only. They never replace SciXZ evidence-location checks, reporting review, statistical review, human/editorial judgment, or user authorization for an upload.

tools.name: PaperReview.ai

input_policy.default: Do not upload anything unless the user explicitly authorizes this exact external upload. The email is read only from a local environment variable and is never logged.
input_policy.minimum_scope: Use a de-identified English PDF and disclose the provider page-limit boundary. Do not record or transmit email addresses in SciXZ artifacts.

provider_constraints.provider_evidence_basis: Provider states recommendations are derived primarily from arXiv papers.
provider_constraints.provider_disclaimer: Provider states that AI-generated reviews may contain mistakes.

evidence_limits: Not a medical reporting-guideline, statistical, ethics, or clinical-validity review.
Not a substitute for a journal's editorial or peer-review decision.
Findings require conversion to evidence-anchored issues and independent verification before revision.
